guide.snc_energies.body.0: Five tiers: Colonial → Steam → Electromechanical → Agroindustrial → Voltaic. Start with crops, a mill and a press; mine tin for bronze. The steam foundry makes steel, the rolling mill makes plates and wire, the dryer makes insulated plates and the refinery prepares Voltaite. Following pages explain operation. Existing machines retain their data; new crafting follows the tiers.
guide.snc_energies.body.1: Rice seed: wheat seeds + wheat. Soybean seed: wheat seeds + beetroot seeds. Plant on farmland near water and light. Bonemeal speeds growth. Mature crops yield 2 products and 2 seeds. Mills and presses require a 2×1 footprint and 2 blocks of height. Breaking any part dismantles the structure and returns the inventory.
guide.snc_energies.body.2: Input on the left; product and residue on the right. Crank to store work (up to 4 charges). No work is spent while input is missing or output is blocked. Craft three flour or three milled rice into bread.
guide.snc_energies.body.3: This press does not replace the Adventures grape press. It processes soybeans and compacts husks. Three soybean meal craft into bonemeal. Oil is an ingredient portion with no returnable bottle. Keep both output slots available.
guide.snc_energies.body.4: In the stove: rice husk produces 8,000 E; vegetable oil 32,000 E; biomass briquette 40,000 E. Compacting four husks improves yield. A full stove pauses fuel consumption. Its footprint is 3×2 with a chimney reaching 3 blocks high.
guide.snc_energies.body.5: With Adventures installed, bagasse from its mill fuels the stove: 8,000 E per item. Drinks, money, recipes and UV lamps keep their original rules. Adventures machine motors, pipes and powered UV are not implemented yet. Both mods can start independently.
guide.snc_energies.body.6: Hoppers insert ingredients above or beside the controller (bottom left from the front); below they extract products and residues. Other parts share the menu but have no separate inventory. Cranking is manual in this tier. Progress and work are saved; unloaded chunks pause processing. Craft this guide with a book and wheat seeds.
guide.snc_energies.industry_base: Controller: front bottom left. Connect electric power there; steam may enter any part. Hoppers insert above/beside and extract below the controller. Each panel labels its ingredient, reagent, product and residue slots; outputs are on the right. Processing pauses when resources are missing or outputs are blocked. Footprint: %s.
guide.snc_energies.boiler: Use the labeled Fuel and Water slots. The empty container exits through the Bucket slot. Each bucket adds 1,000 mB water; the boiler uses 10 mB/t to produce 80 mB/t steam. Fuel pauses without water or when full. Steam ducts are separate from power cables. Bronze: craft 3 copper + 1 tin. Tin generates in new chunks between Y -16 and 80.
guide.snc_energies.turbine: Consumes 80 mB/t steam and generates 80 E/t. Attach power cables to its controller. Full internal buffers pause generation. Redstone port configuration is not implemented in this milestone.
guide.snc_energies.synthesis: The sample in the second slot is retained. Each batch consumes 1 matrix and 160,000 E to produce 2 raw ores. The refinery makes matrix from cobblestone and oil. This technology is fictional. It cannot generate coal or fuel, avoiding a free energy loop.
guide.snc_energies.body.7: Yerba mate seeds: wheat seeds + oak sapling. Grow on farmland and harvest mature leaves. Dry leaves in a furnace or industrial dryer, then grind them in the mill. Craft ground mate + bowl + water bucket into an infusion. Crafting returns the bucket; drinking returns the bowl. This optional branch does not gate industrial progression.
guide.snc_energies.craft.biomass_boiler: Crafting grid (top to bottom): BBB / BFB / CCC. B = Bronze Ingot; F = Furnace; C = Bricks.
guide.snc_energies.craft.steam_sawmill: Crafting grid (top to bottom): III / BGB / PPP. I = Iron Ingot; B = Bronze Ingot; G = Colonial Grain Mill; P = Planks.
guide.snc_energies.craft.steam_foundry: Crafting grid (top to bottom): BBB / IFI / CCC. B = Bronze Ingot; I = Iron Ingot; F = Furnace; C = Bricks.
guide.snc_energies.craft.steam_turbine: Crafting grid (top to bottom): SBS / BIB / SBS. S = Steel Ingot; B = Bronze Ingot; I = Block of Iron.
guide.snc_energies.craft.laminator: Crafting grid (top to bottom): SSS / BRB / SSS. S = Steel Ingot; B = Bronze Ingot; R = Redstone Dust.
guide.snc_energies.craft.grain_dryer: Crafting grid (top to bottom): PPP / GCG / PFP. P = Steel Plate; G = Steel Gear; C = Electromechanical Circuit; F = Furnace.
guide.snc_energies.craft.oil_extractor: Crafting grid (top to bottom): PCP / GSG / PPP. P = Steel Plate; G = Steel Gear; C = Electromechanical Circuit; S = Colonial Seed Press.
guide.snc_energies.craft.voltaic_refiner: Crafting grid (top to bottom): PCP / PGP / PCP. P = Insulated Plate; C = Electromechanical Circuit; G = Steel Gear.
guide.snc_energies.craft.mineral_synthes: Crafting grid (top to bottom): PAP / VRV / PAP. P = Insulated Plate; A = Voltaic Circuit; V = Refined Voltaite; R = Diamond.
guide.snc_energies.transport: Item ducts move one item at a time towards a machine or hopper adjacent to the network; they store nothing and only move items the destination accepts. Hoppers still insert above/beside and extract below the controller. The synthesizer panel button toggles always-on or redstone-only operation. The screwdriver configures each industrial side (input, output or both) and, while sneaking, inverts the redstone mode. Click a duct to edit the cell whitelist.
gui.snc_energies.screwdriver.tooltip: Configures industrial machine sides; sneak to invert the redstone mode.
gui.snc_energies.pipe_filter.title: Item Duct Filter
gui.snc_energies.pipe_filter.hint: The duct only pulls or accepts items on the list. Use the button to clear it.
gui.snc_energies.tractor.tooltip: Use the item on a tractor to open its supply panel.
gui.snc_energies.planter.tooltip: Three-row implement. Place it in the world and use the tractor's hitch button.
gui.snc_energies.harvester.tooltip: Use the item on a harvester to open its supply panel.
Use the item on a harvester to open its supply panel.
gui.snc_energies.grain_cart.tooltip: Use the item on a grain cart to open its cargo panel.
guide.snc_energies.tractor: SNC 75 tractor: click the ground to place it and sit down to drive. Vegetable oil yields 400 ticks per portion (5,200 tank). Put seeds into the panel rows: the planter seeds three rows over already tilled soil, never replacing blocks nor spending seeds where a crop already stands. Panel buttons start the engine and raise the planter.
